description: Open crypto and Web3 funding opportunities builders can still apply to — grant programs, hackathons, bug bounties, accelerators, RFPs — updated daily, 50 per page: name, summary, amount as announced (and in USD when stated in dollars), deadline and the announcement's link. Search names and summaries with query (e.g. a chain or ecosystem); sort by deadline, amount or name. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

query.description: Only opportunities whose name or summary contains this text.

sort_by.description: deadline (soonest first), amount (largest USD first) or name; by default dated ones soonest first, then undated ones newest first.
